meta.title: QuickFix for 1308 fails if a generid type is present
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#46467 (fix(46466): add missing async keyword before type parameters)
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.4.4 (2021-10-12) and typescript@4.5.2 (2021-11-17), both behind typescript-language-server@0.7.1 (the latest wrapper release before 4.5.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js (--tsserver-path); the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. The code fix itself is old (the reporter saw the bug from 3.7.5 on).
meta.notes: Pilot substitute for tsserver #49964 (quick fix produces bad code), which has no stable pre-fix build: the add-extends-constraint code fix did not exist in 4.7.4 (fixAddMissingConstraint.ts absent at v4.7.4, present at v4.8.2), and its fix-all route is not exposed by typescript-language-server.

settings_note: The issue names no compiler options (its playground link sets JSX to none, so the file is a .ts file); tsconfig.json is minimal scaffolding.

files.note: strict checking and an ES2017 target (Promise and async functions resolve); the issue names no options

repro.steps: Open index.ts: the await inside the generic arrow function that is not async is reported (TS1308). Apply the quick fix 'Add async modifier to containing function'. Reported: the fix inserts async after the type parameters ('<T>async (x: T): Promise<string> =>'), which does not parse; expected 'async <T>(x: T): Promise<string> =>'. Probe: the fixed text must not have a parse error the original did not have.
